brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.evidence: Linear 3-cell organizer: bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full (open tray) provide sorted storage for tapes, scissors/tweezers, thread/bobbins, fabric pieces. House rules run: caps and joint bolts.
Configurator remained BUSY settling props (tape, ruler, tweezers etc.) for 17 consecutive attempts; no prop could be placed to illustrate contents. Structure itself shows purpose via varied bins.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell Hex Cluster organizer with compartmentalized bins for sewing supplies; caps and joints locked. Prop dressing repeatedly returned BUSY from server settling, so delivered as unadorned but functional tray.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
